context: Move every content assertion in home.spec.ts to after waitForDataLoaded, and assert at least one landmark that exists only on the loaded page so the test cannot pass against a skeleton. Re-audit the spec's other assertions on the same suspicion.
description: e2e/routes/home.spec.ts asserts its heading on line 9, four lines BEFORE the data wait on line 13. Because the retired headline existed only in HomeLoadingSkeleton, that assertion has only ever matched the loading state. Proven 2026-08-03 by a three-case Playwright probe on develop 3af42e29b: asserting the heading before data load passed in 152ms, the identical assertion after data load failed, and the loaded page instead showed the curated-preview copy. This @smoke test therefore never validated the loaded Home page, and it is one of the tests gating Firefox and WebKit.

preserves.behavior: Assertions use real navigation and real locators, never synthetic events
Corpus-summary singular and plural coverage is retained
The test stays tagged @smoke so Firefox and WebKit keep running it

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && awk 'BEGIN{w=0;h=0} /await waitForDataLoaded/{if(!w)w=NR} /getByRole..heading/{if(!h)h=NR} END{exit !(w && h && w<h)}' e2e/routes/home.spec.ts
verifications.description: Data wait precedes the first heading assertion
verifications.expected: Exit 0 only when the spec waits for data before asserting page content

verifications.expected: Home route tests pass against loaded content
